<div class="wrap">
<h1>Filing red flags</h1>
<p class="sub">Going concern, restatement, material weakness, auditor change, investigation, and bankruptcy hits already tagged on the SEC filings-intel feed. These are keyword/event matches from EDGAR full text, not a full 10-K parse. Click a header to sort. Blank is missing, not zero.</p>
<div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
<input id="q" placeholder="filter ticker or signal" autocomplete="off">
<div id="board">Loading /data/sec-filings-intel.json</div>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> isolating the control-failure and distress events inside the existing filings-intel tape.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/sec-filings-intel.json (all_tickers[], critical[], events with ticker, form, filed_at, signal_id, polarity, severity, weight, filing_url).<br>
<b>Signals kept here:</b> going_concern, restatement, material_weakness, auditor_change, investigation, bankruptcy.<br>
<b>Not:</b> a new 8-K guidance parser. The broader 14-signal board remains on /sec-filings.html. Research only.</div>
</div>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];});}
var KEEP={going_concern:1,restatement:1,material_weakness:1,auditor_change:1,investigation:1,bankruptcy:1};
var SORT="filed_at", DIR=-1, PACK=null, ROWS=[];
function cmp(a,b){
  var av=a[SORT], bv=b[SORT];
  if(av==null||av==="") return 1; if(bv==null||bv==="") return -1;
  if(SORT==="weight"||SORT==="score") return (Number(av)-Number(bv))*DIR;
  if(SORT==="filed_at") return ((Date.parse(av)||0)-(Date.parse(bv)||0))*DIR;
  return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*DIR;
}
function flatten(d){
  var out=[], seen={};
  function add(ev){
    if(!ev||!KEEP[ev.signal_id]) return;
    var k=(ev.ticker||"")+"|"+(ev.accession||"")+"|"+(ev.signal_id||"");
    if(seen[k]) return; seen[k]=1;
    out.push({
      ticker:ev.ticker||"", name:ev.name||"", form:ev.form||"",
      filed_at:ev.filed_at||"", signal_id:ev.signal_id||"", signal_label:ev.signal_label||ev.signal_id||"",
      polarity:ev.polarity||"", severity:ev.severity||"", weight:ev.weight,
      filing_url:ev.filing_url||"", snippet:ev.snippet||""
    });
  }
  (d.critical||[]).forEach(function(row){ (row.events||[row]).forEach(add); });
  (d.all_tickers||[]).forEach(function(row){ (row.events||[]).forEach(add); });
  (d.opportunities||[]).forEach(function(row){ (row.events||[row]).forEach(add); });
  return out;
}
function paint(){
  var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
  var list=ROWS.filter(function(r){
    if(!q) return true;
    return (r.ticker+" "+r.name+" "+r.signal_id+" "+r.signal_label).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
  }).sort(cmp);
  var h='<table><thead><tr>';
  [["filed_at","Filed"],["ticker","Ticker"],["signal_label","Signal"],["form","Form"],["severity","Severity"],["weight","Weight"]].forEach(function(c){
    h+='<th class="'+(SORT===c[0]?"on":"")+'" data-k="'+c[0]+'">'+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR<0?" \u2193":" \u2191"):"")+"</th>";
  });
  h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
  list.forEach(function(r){
    h+="<tr><td>"+esc(String(r.filed_at).replace("T"," ").slice(0,19))+"</td>";
    h+="<td><a href=\"/ticker.html?symbol="+encodeURIComponent(r.ticker)+"\">"+esc(r.ticker)+"</a></td>";
    h+='<td class="'+(r.polarity==="bearish"?"bear":"bull")+'">'+(r.filing_url?"<a href=\""+esc(r.filing_url)+"\" target=_blank rel=noopener>"+esc(r.signal_label)+"</a>":esc(r.signal_label))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+esc(r.form)+"</td><td>"+esc(r.severity)+"</td><td>"+(r.weight==null?"":r.weight)+"</td></tr>";
  });
  document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table><p class=sub>"+list.length+" of "+ROWS.length+" tagged red-flag events. Generated "+esc((PACK&&PACK.generated_at)||"")+".</p>";
  document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]").forEach(function(el){
    el.onclick=function(){var k=el.getAttribute("data-k"); if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR; else {SORT=k; DIR=k==="ticker"||k==="signal_label"||k==="form"||k==="severity"?1:-1;} paint();};
  });
}
(async function(){
  var d=null;
  try{var r=await fetch("/data/sec-filings-intel.json?t="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}); if(r.ok)d=await r.json();}catch(e){}
  if(!d){document.getElementById("board").textContent="sec-filings-intel.json missing.";return;}
  PACK=d; ROWS=flatten(d);
  document.getElementById("kpis").innerHTML=
    '<span class="chip"><b>'+ROWS.length+"</b> red-flag events</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(d.n_tickers_with_signals||0)+"</b> names on full intel tape</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><a href=\"/sec-filings.html\">full 14-signal desk</a></span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><a href=\"/8k-items.html\">8-K item tape</a></span>';
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint; paint();
})();
</script>
